services.name: Dental Check-up
services.description: A thorough oral examination to assess your dental health, detect issues early, and plan the right course of treatment.
services.preparation: No special preparation needed. Bring any previous dental records or X-rays if available.

services.name: Teeth Cleaning
services.description: Professional prophylaxis to remove plaque, tartar, and surface stains — leaving your teeth clean, polished, and feeling fresh.
involves: Ultrasonic scaling to remove tartar buildup
services.preparation: Brush your teeth normally before your visit. Avoid a heavy meal right before your appointment.

services.name: Tooth Filling
services.description: Tooth-colored composite fillings to restore teeth damaged by cavities, restoring both function and natural appearance.
services.preparation: Eat a light meal beforehand — the treated area may be numb for a few hours after the procedure.

services.name: Tooth Extraction
services.description: Safe, minimally painful removal of a severely damaged, decayed, or problematic tooth by our experienced dentists.
services.preparation: Avoid blood-thinning medications if possible. Arrange for someone to accompany you if sedation is used.

services.name: Teeth Whitening
services.description: Professional in-office whitening that safely lightens your enamel by several shades for a brighter, more confident smile.
involves: LED light activation for enhanced results
services.preparation: Avoid strongly colored foods and beverages 48 hours before and after treatment. Treat any cavities before whitening.

services.name: Wisdom Tooth Extraction
services.description: Safe removal of impacted or problematic wisdom teeth to relieve pain, prevent crowding, and avoid future complications.
services.preparation: Fast for at least 6 hours before sedation. Arrange for someone to accompany you home.

services.name: Partial Dentures
services.description: Removable partial dentures designed to replace one or more missing teeth while preserving your remaining natural teeth.
involves: Wax try-in for fit and comfort review
services.preparation: Multiple visits are required. Inform your dentist of any existing health conditions or medications.

services.name: Full Dentures
services.description: Complete removable dentures for patients who have lost all or most of their natural teeth, restoring appearance and function.
involves: Impressions for both upper and lower arches
Wax try-in appointments for aesthetics and fit
services.preparation: Multiple visits over several weeks are needed. Bring a list of any current medications to your first appointment.

services.name: Pediatric Dental Care
services.description: Child-friendly dental check-ups, cleanings, and preventive treatments in a calm environment designed for young patients.
involves: Parent education on home care habits
services.preparation: Bring your child's dental records if available. Morning appointments are usually best for young children.

services.name: Veneers
services.description: Thin, custom-made porcelain or composite shells bonded to the front of teeth to improve color, shape, size, or length.
involves: Initial smile assessment and shade selection
Minimal enamel removal for bonding surface
Impression or digital scan for fabrication
Temporary veneers placed while lab fabricates finals
Permanent veneer bonding and bite check
services.preparation: Discuss aesthetic goals with your dentist beforehand. Good oral health is required before veneers are placed.

services.name: Braces Consultation & Adjustment
services.description: Orthodontic consultation, treatment assessment, and scheduled braces adjustment — all in one visit.
involves: Bracket checks and tightening as needed
Photos and documentation of treatment progress
services.preparation: Brush thoroughly before your visit. Eat a soft meal beforehand — teeth may feel tender after adjustment.

services.name: Braces Installation
services.description: Initial placement of orthodontic braces to gradually align and straighten the teeth. Includes both upper and lower arches.
involves: Initial orthodontic consultation and full assessment
Placement of metal brackets on upper and lower arches
Patient education on care and maintenance
Final retainer quoted separately after treatment
services.preparation: An initial consultation is required before installation. Additional procedures (X-rays, fillings, extractions) may be needed and are quoted separately.

services.name: Retainer
services.description: A custom-made retainer to maintain your teeth alignment after braces treatment is complete.
involves: Instructions on wear schedule and maintenance
services.preparation: Retainer is placed after braces are removed. Bring any previous orthodontic records to your appointment.

dentists.name: Dr. Maria Santos
dentists.title: DMD
dentists.bio: Dr. Santos is a dedicated general and cosmetic dentist with 8 years of experience transforming smiles across Cebu City. She earned her DMD from the University of Santo Tomas and has completed advanced training in cosmetic dentistry and minimally invasive procedures. Known for her gentle approach and thorough explanations, she makes every patient feel at ease.

dentists.name: Dr. Adrian Reyes
dentists.title: DMD, MOrth
dentists.bio: Dr. Reyes is an experienced orthodontist specializing in braces, clear aligners, and bite correction. He completed his Masters in Orthodontics from the University of the Philippines Manila and has treated hundreds of patients from teenagers to adults. He combines clinical precision with a warm, patient-centered style to deliver results that last a lifetime.
